quests.instruction: Choose the best summary for the paragraph.
quests.passage: Before the school year starts, Mrs. Ortiz takes her three children shopping for supplies. The first store has run out of notebooks, so they drive to a second store nearby. By evening, every child has new pencils, folders, and a backpack ready for class.
options: A Shopping Trip to Find School Supplies for Three Kids
A Store That Has Plenty of Notebooks
Children Who Already Own School Supplies
A Shopping Trip Canceled Due to Rain
quests.correctAnswer: A Shopping Trip to Find School Supplies for Three Kids
quests.hint: Notice why the family visits two stores and what they end up with.
quests.explanation: The passage follows a shopping trip that hits one obstacle, the empty shelves, but still succeeds, so the summary should reflect the overall goal and outcome, not just the first store's problem.

quests.instruction: Choose the best summary for the paragraph.
quests.passage: Many restaurants in the city have started offering smaller portion sizes at lower prices. Customers can order a half-size plate instead of a full meal. This change helps people avoid wasting food and saves them money at the same time.
options: Restaurants Raising Prices on Full Meals
Restaurants Offering Smaller, Cheaper Portions to Cut Waste
Customers Forced to Order Large Portions
A City Banning Half-Size Plates
quests.correctAnswer: Restaurants Offering Smaller, Cheaper Portions to Cut Waste
quests.hint: Think about the new menu option and the two benefits it brings to customers.
quests.explanation: The passage connects the smaller-portion option with both less food waste and lower cost, so the best summary should mention the change and both benefits together.

quests.instruction: Choose the best summary for the paragraph.
quests.passage: A new app helps people find the cheapest gas stations near them. Drivers type in their location, and the app shows nearby prices instantly. Many drivers say the app has saved them a noticeable amount of money every month.
options: An App That Only Shows Traffic Information
Drivers Who Say the App Wastes Time
An App That Helps Drivers Find Cheap Gas
Gas Prices That Are the Same Everywhere
quests.correctAnswer: An App That Helps Drivers Find Cheap Gas
quests.hint: Think about what the app does and how drivers have benefited from using it.
quests.explanation: The passage explains the app's function and the savings it provides, so the summary should link the tool to the financial benefit, not just describe the search feature alone.

quests.instruction: Choose the best summary for the paragraph.
quests.passage: Many office workers spend hours sitting at a desk every day, which can lead to back pain over time. Doctors now recommend standing up and stretching every thirty minutes. Companies are starting to provide standing desks to help employees stay healthier.
options: Doctors Recommending Workers Sit All Day
Standing Desks That Caused More Pain
Office Workers Who Never Sit Down
Companies Adding Standing Desks to Reduce Back Pain
quests.correctAnswer: Companies Adding Standing Desks to Reduce Back Pain
quests.hint: Think about the problem with sitting too long and the solution companies are trying.
quests.explanation: The passage moves from a health problem to a workplace solution, so the summary should connect the back-pain issue with the standing-desk response, not just one part of the chain.

quests.instruction: Choose the best summary for the paragraph.
quests.passage: A streaming service recently added subtitles in over forty languages for its most popular shows. Viewers from many countries can now follow the dialogue more easily. The company says this change has brought in many new international subscribers.
options: A Streaming Service Removing All Subtitles
Subtitles Available in Only One Language
New Subtitles Bringing International Viewers to a Streaming Service
A Drop in International Subscribers
quests.correctAnswer: New Subtitles Bringing International Viewers to a Streaming Service
quests.hint: Think about what the company added and the effect it had on its audience.
quests.explanation: The passage links a feature change with business growth, so the summary should connect the new subtitles to the rise in subscribers rather than describing only the feature.

quests.instruction: Choose the best summary for the paragraph.
quests.passage: A notice posted outside the apartment building announced that the water would be shut off for repairs on Friday morning. Residents were asked to fill containers with water the night before. Most residents prepared in time, and the repair finished without any major problems.
options: A Notice Warning Residents About a Planned Water Shutoff
A Notice Announcing a Permanent Water Shutoff
Residents Who Ignored the Warning Completely
Repairs That Caused Major Problems for Everyone
quests.correctAnswer: A Notice Warning Residents About a Planned Water Shutoff
quests.hint: Think about what the notice warned residents about and how they responded.
quests.explanation: The passage describes both the warning and the residents' successful preparation, so the summary should capture the notice's purpose and the smooth outcome that followed.

quests.instruction: Choose the best summary for the paragraph.
quests.passage: Since moving into a smaller apartment, Tomas has learned to get rid of things he does not use. Every month, he donates a box of clothes or books he no longer needs. He says his home feels calmer with less clutter around him.
options: Tomas Buying More Things Each Month
A Monthly Habit of Donating Unused Items
A Habit Tomas Started Before Moving
A Cluttered Home That Tomas Prefers
quests.correctAnswer: A Monthly Habit of Donating Unused Items
quests.hint: Think about what Tomas does each month and how it makes him feel.
quests.explanation: The passage shows a regular decluttering habit and its calming effect, so the summary should connect the donating with the feeling it creates, not just describe the move itself.

quests.instruction: Choose the best summary for the paragraph.
quests.passage: This semester, the high school introduced a peer-tutoring program where older students help younger ones with homework. Tutors meet with their assigned students twice a week in the library. Teachers have noticed that test scores have slowly started to improve.
options: Tutors Who Meet Once a Year
A Program Open Only to Teachers
Test Scores That Have Gotten Worse
A Peer-Tutoring Program Linked to Better Test Scores
quests.correctAnswer: A Peer-Tutoring Program Linked to Better Test Scores
quests.hint: Think about how the tutoring program works and what change teachers have observed.
quests.explanation: The passage connects the new tutoring system with a gradual academic improvement, so the summary should reflect both the program and its measurable effect.

quests.instruction: Choose the best summary for the paragraph.
quests.passage: After working from home for two years, Devon's company asked employees to return to the office three days a week. Many workers were unsure how they felt about the change at first. After a month, most said they actually enjoyed seeing their coworkers again.
options: A Company That Banned Working from Home Forever
Workers Who Refused to Return at All
Workers Adjusting Well to a Partial Return to the Office
Employees Who Disliked Seeing Their Coworkers
quests.correctAnswer: Workers Adjusting Well to a Partial Return to the Office
quests.hint: Think about how workers felt at first compared to how they felt after a month.
quests.explanation: The passage tracks a change in attitude over time, so the summary should reflect the shift from uncertainty to enjoyment, not just the initial reaction.

quests.instruction: Choose the best summary for the paragraph.
quests.passage: Renting a car for their road trip turned out to be cheaper than Marco and his friends expected. They split the cost evenly among four people and saved money compared to buying separate train tickets. The flexibility of driving also let them stop at small towns along the way.
options: A Road Trip That Cost More Than Train Tickets
Friends Saving Money by Sharing a Rental Car
Marco Traveling Alone Without Any Friends
A Car Rental That Limited Their Stops
quests.correctAnswer: Friends Saving Money by Sharing a Rental Car
quests.hint: Think about how the friends paid for the car and what extra benefit they got from driving.
quests.explanation: The passage highlights both the cost savings and the freedom to stop along the way, so the summary should capture the overall advantage of their choice, not just one detail.

quests.instruction: Choose the best summary for the paragraph.
quests.passage: When Leila's grandmother moved in with the family last year, everyone had to adjust to a new daily rhythm. Leila now helps her grandmother with simple tasks in the morning before school. The two have grown much closer because of this time together.
options: A Grandmother Who Lives Far Away
Leila Avoiding Time with Her Grandmother
A Family That Never Adjusted to the Change
A Family Growing Closer After a Grandmother Moves In
quests.correctAnswer: A Family Growing Closer After a Grandmother Moves In
quests.hint: Think about the change the family went through and what positive result came from it.
quests.explanation: The passage moves from an adjustment period to a stronger relationship, so the summary should connect the living arrangement with the bond it created.

quests.instruction: Choose the best summary for the paragraph.
quests.passage: During the end-of-season clearance sale, Priya noticed that prices dropped a little more each day the items stayed unsold. She waited a full week before buying a winter coat at half its original price. Her patience paid off with a much better deal.
options: Patience Rewarded with a Bigger Clearance Discount
Priya Buying the Coat on the First Day
Prices That Increased Throughout the Sale
A Sale That Ended Before Priya Could Buy
quests.correctAnswer: Patience Rewarded with a Bigger Clearance Discount
quests.hint: Think about why Priya waited and what she gained from waiting.
quests.explanation: The passage links Priya's strategy of waiting with the bigger discount she received, so the summary should show that cause-and-effect relationship rather than just describing the sale.

quests.instruction: Choose the best summary for the paragraph.
quests.passage: A nearby bakery recently switched to using only locally grown wheat for its bread. The owner says the new flour gives the bread a slightly different, nuttier flavor. Sales have grown since regular customers started recommending the bread to their friends.
options: A Bakery That Stopped Selling Bread
A Bakery's Switch to Local Wheat Boosting Sales
Bread That Tastes Exactly the Same as Before
Sales That Dropped After the Recipe Change
quests.correctAnswer: A Bakery's Switch to Local Wheat Boosting Sales
quests.hint: Think about what changed in the bakery's recipe and how that affected business.
quests.explanation: The passage connects a recipe change with both a flavor difference and rising sales, so the summary should tie the ingredient switch to its positive business result.

quests.instruction: Choose the best summary for the paragraph.
quests.passage: Many students now use a note-taking app that automatically organizes class notes by subject and date. The app also lets students search for any word across all their notes instantly. Several teachers say it has made studying for exams much faster for their students.
options: An App That Only Stores Photos
Teachers Who Say the App Slows Studying
A Note App That Makes Studying Faster
Notes That Cannot Be Searched at All
quests.correctAnswer: A Note App That Makes Studying Faster
quests.hint: Think about what the app organizes and searches, and how that helps students prepare for tests.
quests.explanation: The passage describes the app's two main features and their effect on studying speed, so the summary should connect the tool to its time-saving benefit.

quests.instruction: Choose the best summary for the paragraph.
quests.passage: After a sleep study, Karim learned that his snoring was disrupting his deep sleep every night. His doctor suggested sleeping on his side instead of his back. Within two weeks, Karim felt noticeably more rested during the day.
options: A Doctor Who Suggested Sleeping on His Back
Karim Feeling More Tired After Two Weeks
A Sleep Study That Found No Problems
A Sleep Change That Helped Karim Feel More Rested
quests.correctAnswer: A Sleep Change That Helped Karim Feel More Rested
quests.hint: Think about what the sleep study found and what change helped solve the problem.
quests.explanation: The passage moves from a diagnosed problem to a simple solution with a clear result, so the summary should connect the cause, the fix, and the improvement.

quests.instruction: Choose the best summary for the paragraph.
quests.passage: A small independent film won an unexpected award at a major festival this year. The director had spent almost no money on advertising before the festival began. After the win, ticket sales increased dramatically across several countries.
options: An Award Boosting Sales for a Small Film
A Film That Spent Millions on Advertising
Ticket Sales That Dropped After the Award
A Festival That Rejected the Film Completely
quests.correctAnswer: An Award Boosting Sales for a Small Film
quests.hint: Think about the film's situation before the award and what changed afterward.
quests.explanation: The passage shows how winning an award changed the film's fortunes, so the summary should connect the award with the rise in ticket sales.

quests.instruction: Choose the best summary for the paragraph.
quests.passage: A customer service chatbot on a shopping website answered Mara's question about a delayed package within seconds. When the answer was not detailed enough, the chatbot quickly connected her to a real person. Mara said the combination felt faster than calling a phone line.
options: A Chatbot That Never Answers Any Questions
Mara Waiting Hours for a Response
A Phone Line That Was Faster Than Chat
A Chatbot That Quickly Connects Customers to Real Help
quests.correctAnswer: A Chatbot That Quickly Connects Customers to Real Help
quests.hint: Think about how the chatbot handled Mara's question and what happened when it could not fully help.
quests.explanation: The passage describes a smooth handoff from automated to human support, so the summary should reflect that combination, not just the chatbot's first response.

quests.instruction: Choose the best summary for the paragraph.
quests.passage: Noticing how much plastic her family threw away each week, Yasmin started bringing reusable bags and containers everywhere. She also began buying items in bulk to cut down on packaging. After a few months, the household's trash had visibly shrunk.
options: Yasmin Buying More Plastic Packaging
A Family Shrinking Its Trash Through Simple Habits
A Household That Stopped Recycling Entirely
Trash That Increased After a Few Months
quests.correctAnswer: A Family Shrinking Its Trash Through Simple Habits
quests.hint: Think about the changes Yasmin made and the result those changes had over time.
quests.explanation: The passage links several small habit changes to a visible reduction in waste, so the summary should capture the overall result, not a single action like the bags.

quests.instruction: Choose the best summary for the paragraph.
quests.passage: The middle school replaced its old textbooks with tablets loaded with interactive lessons this year. Students can now watch short videos and complete quizzes that adjust to their skill level. Early results show that struggling students are catching up faster than before.
options: Tablets That Removed All Quizzes
A School That Returned to Old Textbooks
Tablets Helping Struggling Students Catch Up Faster
Struggling Students Falling Further Behind
quests.correctAnswer: Tablets Helping Struggling Students Catch Up Faster
quests.hint: Think about what replaced the textbooks and what early results are showing.
quests.explanation: The passage links the new technology to faster progress for struggling students, so the summary should connect the tool with that specific outcome.

quests.instruction: Choose the best summary for the paragraph.
quests.passage: Since switching to a four-day work week, employees at a small marketing firm report feeling less exhausted by Friday. The company tracked productivity and found it stayed roughly the same despite the shorter week. Several other local businesses are now considering the same change.
options: A Four-Day Week That Kept Productivity Steady
A Four-Day Week That Cut Productivity in Half
Employees Who Feel More Exhausted Now
A Company That Returned to Five Days Immediately
quests.correctAnswer: A Four-Day Week That Kept Productivity Steady
quests.hint: Think about what changed at the company and what the productivity numbers showed.
quests.explanation: The passage connects the shorter week with stable output and employee wellbeing, so the summary should reflect both the change and the data behind it.

quests.instruction: Choose the best summary for the paragraph.
quests.passage: A budget airline added a new direct route between two mid-sized cities that previously required a layover. Travelers say the trip now takes half the time it used to. Local tourism officials hope the new route will bring more visitors to the region.
options: A Route That Added an Extra Layover
Travelers Who Say the Trip Takes Longer Now
A New Direct Flight Cutting Travel Time in Half
Tourism Officials Hoping for Fewer Visitors
quests.correctAnswer: A New Direct Flight Cutting Travel Time in Half
quests.hint: Think about what changed about the flight route and the time it now takes.
quests.explanation: The passage shows a route change with a clear time benefit and a hopeful business impact, so the summary should connect the new route with the shorter travel time.

quests.instruction: Choose the best summary for the paragraph.
quests.passage: Raising three children with very different personalities taught the Andersons to adjust their parenting approach for each child. What worked to calm their oldest did not always work for their youngest. Over the years, they learned to treat each child as an individual rather than following one fixed method.
options: Parents Using One Method for All Three Children
Parents Adjusting Their Approach for Each Child
Children Who All Have the Same Personality
A Family That Never Changed Its Methods
quests.correctAnswer: Parents Adjusting Their Approach for Each Child
quests.hint: Think about why one parenting method did not work for every child and what the parents learned.
quests.explanation: The passage describes a shift from a fixed approach to a flexible one based on experience, so the summary should reflect that overall lesson, not just one example.

quests.instruction: Choose the best summary for the paragraph.
quests.passage: A small bookstore began hosting a 'bring a book, take a book' shelf where customers could trade gently used novels for free. Within weeks, the shelf became a popular meeting spot for regular customers to chat about their favorite reads. The store says foot traffic in that corner has tripled.
options: A Bookstore That Banned Used Books
A Shelf That No Customers Ever Visited
Foot Traffic That Dropped After the Shelf Opened
A Book Swap Shelf Turning into a Popular Gathering Spot
quests.correctAnswer: A Book Swap Shelf Turning into a Popular Gathering Spot
quests.hint: Think about what the shelf was meant for and what it unexpectedly became.
quests.explanation: The passage shows a simple idea growing into a social hub, so the summary should capture both the original purpose and the surprising community result.

quests.instruction: Choose the best summary for the paragraph.
quests.passage: After noticing food allergies among several students, the school cafeteria began clearly labeling every dish with its ingredients. Parents say they finally feel confident letting their children choose their own lunch. The cafeteria staff also created a separate allergy-friendly station for common triggers like peanuts and dairy.
options: A Cafeteria Labeling Food to Help Allergic Students
A Cafeteria That Removed All Labels
Parents Who Feel Less Confident Now
A School That Ignored Food Allergies
quests.correctAnswer: A Cafeteria Labeling Food to Help Allergic Students
quests.hint: Think about the problem the cafeteria noticed and the two changes it made to address it.
quests.explanation: The passage connects a safety concern with two specific solutions and their reassuring effect on parents, so the summary should reflect the overall improvement.

quests.instruction: Choose the best summary for the paragraph.
quests.passage: A small startup created a wristband that gently vibrates when the wearer has been sitting too long. Office workers who tested it said it reminded them to move without feeling annoying, unlike loud alarms. The company is now expanding the product to track posture as well.
options: A Gentle Wristband Reminder to Move More
A Wristband That Uses Loud Alarms
Workers Who Found the Wristband Annoying
A Company Canceling the Product Entirely
quests.correctAnswer: A Gentle Wristband Reminder to Move More
quests.hint: Think about how the wristband works and how testers reacted to it compared to loud alarms.
quests.explanation: The passage highlights the gentle, effective design of the wristband and its positive reception, so the summary should reflect both qualities together.

quests.instruction: Choose the best summary for the paragraph.
quests.passage: A community center started offering free weekly walking groups for older adults in the neighborhood. Participants walk a short loop through the park while chatting with neighbors. Several members say the group has helped them stay active and make new friends at the same time.
options: A Walking Group Open Only to Children
A Program That Charges a High Fee
A Walking Group Helping Older Adults Stay Active and Social
Members Who Say They Feel More Isolated
quests.correctAnswer: A Walking Group Helping Older Adults Stay Active and Social
quests.hint: Think about who the program serves and the two benefits members mention.
quests.explanation: The passage describes both the physical and social benefits of the program, so the summary should capture that dual purpose rather than just the walking itself.

quests.instruction: Choose the best summary for the paragraph.
quests.passage: A local radio station decided to let listeners vote on which song plays every hour using a simple text message system. Listenership grew noticeably within the first month, especially among younger audiences. The station now plans to expand the voting system to weekend shows as well.
options: A Radio Station That Removed All Listener Input
Listenership That Dropped After the Change
A Voting System Limited to Older Audiences
Listener Voting Helping a Radio Station Grow Its Audience
quests.correctAnswer: Listener Voting Helping a Radio Station Grow Its Audience
quests.hint: Think about what new feature the station added and how listeners responded to it.
quests.explanation: The passage links the voting feature with audience growth, especially among younger listeners, so the summary should connect the feature with that specific result.

quests.instruction: Choose the best summary for the paragraph.
quests.passage: An automated email confirmed that Priya's online order had shipped, including a tracking number and an estimated delivery date. When the package was delayed by two days, a follow-up email apologized and offered a small discount on her next purchase. Priya appreciated being kept informed throughout the process.
options: An Email That Never Mentioned the Delay
Clear Emails Keeping a Customer Informed Through a Delay
A Company That Ignored the Late Package
Priya Receiving No Information About Her Order
quests.correctAnswer: Clear Emails Keeping a Customer Informed Through a Delay
quests.hint: Think about what each email told Priya and how that affected her experience.
quests.explanation: The passage shows a company communicating proactively even when something went wrong, so the summary should reflect the overall positive communication, not just the tracking number.

quests.instruction: Choose the best summary for the paragraph.
quests.passage: To save time on busy weekday mornings, Hugo started preparing his lunch and choosing his clothes the night before. What used to be a rushed and stressful morning routine now takes him only fifteen minutes. He says the small change has made his whole day start more calmly.
options: Hugo Preparing Lunch in the Morning Instead
A Routine That Now Takes Two Hours
Evening Prep Turning Rushed Mornings Calm
Mornings That Became More Stressful Over Time
quests.correctAnswer: Evening Prep Turning Rushed Mornings Calm
quests.hint: Think about what Hugo changed and how his mornings are different now.
quests.explanation: The passage contrasts Hugo's old rushed mornings with his new calm routine, so the summary should capture that before-and-after change caused by his evening preparation.

quests.instruction: Choose the best summary for the paragraph.
quests.passage: A high school science fair this year required every project to solve a real problem in the local community rather than just demonstrate a scientific concept. One student designed a low-cost water filter for a nearby village with limited clean water access. Judges said the new rule made the entries far more meaningful than in past years.
options: A Science Fair That Banned Practical Projects
A Science Fair Rule Requiring Real Community Solutions
A Student Who Designed a Toy Instead
Judges Who Found the New Entries Less Meaningful
quests.correctAnswer: A Science Fair Rule Requiring Real Community Solutions
quests.hint: Think about the new rule for the science fair and how it changed the kinds of projects students created.
quests.explanation: The passage explains a rule change and its effect on project quality, using one student's example as support, so the summary should focus on the rule and its broader impact, not just the single water filter project.
